_comment: The Skills screen used to derive a label from the id, which gives you 'Cc64' and
'Ii-v-i'. This is the list of what those ids are called, and — for everything that is
a musical skill rather than a feature of this app — how to go and find music that
trains it. `tools/content/finder.py` generates the search query and chat prompt from
the finder block at build time; `validate.py` checks every concept used anywhere is
`levelWords` is derived from the stage the concept is taught at, not authored: the
stage is already the truth about where a skill sits, and 254 hand-written level
descriptions would drift the first time a lesson moved.
